council: Royal Borough of Kingston upon Thames
current_evidence: The council's 'Validation requirements for planning applications' page (downloads/download/261) says the new list was adopted on 1 May 2024 and links the 'Validation Local List' PDF (titled 'Validation Local List - February 2024') and a separate Householder Local List, also dated February 2024; it mentions no newer or draft list.

issues.detail: The 'Validation list URL' is the 'Validation checklist - Section 3' DOCX, the tick-box form applicants complete and submit. The local list itself, with requirements and triggers, is the 'Validation Local List' PDF, and householders have a separate 'Householder Local List' PDF. Grokbot did read both PDFs, but the reference row points to the wrong file.
issues.evidence: List intro: 'The third section (standalone section) provides a checklist to be completed and submitted with each application'

issues.detail: List date 2025-09-01 comes from the DOCX upload folder. The lists are dated February 2024, and the council page says they were adopted on 1 May 2024.
issues.evidence: Footer 'Validation Local List - February 2024'; council page: list adopted 1 May 2024

issues.detail: Many local requirements in the main list are not captured: Heritage Statement (proposals affecting designated/non-designated heritage assets or ground disturbance in an APA, plus schedule of works for listed buildings); Land Contamination Assessment (contaminated/previous industrial sites, majors, sites adjoining public open space); Landscaping Scheme with 5-year management plan (majors); Circular Economy Statement (GLA-referable); Delivery and Servicing Plan (majors); Digital 3D Modelling (majors); Retrofit-first statement (majors involving demolition); Foul Sewage and Utilities Assessment (new units or changes to utility infrastructure); Loss of Community Facilities Assessment; Materials and Architectural Details (majors); Public Art Strategy (majors); Parking Beat/Stress Survey (no parking proposed outside a CPZ); Sequential Test (town centre uses edge/out of centre); Schedule of Accommodation (new residential incl. student/shared); Time Stamped Photographs (all applications); Urban Greening Factor Statement (majors); Wind Impact Assessment (7+ storeys or buildings well above prevailing height); Water Consumption Statement (new residential and all new commercial); Window/door sections 1:10 or 1:20 (window/door changes); Renewable Energy sections (solar panels, ASHPs); 45-degree plans (extensions/outbuildings) and 25-degree elevation (2+ storey extensions); Flood Risk Assessment Form (householders in FZ2/3, surface water risk or a Critical Drainage Area); BREEAM pre-assessment (non-residential over 500 sqm), which appears only as a garbled tab_items fragment.
issues.evidence: Validation Local List Feb 2024, Section 2 Local Requirements

issues.detail: Application types with explicit requirements in the list are recorded as '(none)': Outline has Design Codes, Development Specification and Parameter Plans (all outline majors); Reserved matters has a Reserved Matters Confirmation Statement; Non-material amendment has an S96A schedule of changes plus revised drawings highlighting the changes; Listed building consent needs a Design and Access Statement and a Heritage Statement with schedule of works. Householder has only 5 rows, but the Householder Local List has about 15 local items, incl. 45/25-degree plans, daylight/sunlight report if those tests fail, basement impact assessment, Fire Statement (London Plan), FRA form, Heritage Statement, lighting, parking, time-stamped photographs and tree survey. About 30 other items carry 'INFERRED ... placed under Full planning' although the list gives scope by size (e.g. 'All major applications' for Energy, HIA, Travel Plan, Planning Statement).
issues.evidence: Main list: 'Design Codes - All outline major applications'; 'Reserved Matters Confirmation Statement - All reserved matters applications'; Householder Local List items 15-28

issues.detail: Many triggers come from a different requirement or from guidance text. Daylight/Sunlight uses Biodiversity Checklist text (source: proposals likely to affect light to adjoining land and all major residential). Design and Access Statement uses drawing guidance (source: majors, 1+ dwellings or 100 sqm+ in a CA/WHS, LBC). Planning Obligations uses Archaeological Assessment text (source: all majors). Planning Statement and Viability Assessment use Affordable Housing Statement text (source: Planning Statement all majors; Viability for major residential with under 35% affordable, 50% on public land). Schedule of works (listed building) uses tree AMS text. Open space/play space uses the S106 heads-of-terms list (source: Open Space Assessment where open space is lost). Photographs is 'Certificate CGI Visualisations authorising body.' Validation checklist form (Full planning) uses biodiversity checklist purpose text.
issues.evidence: e.g. Daylight row: 'Biodiversity Checklist All applications A completed Biodiversity Checklist is required for all applications.'

issues.detail: Several other triggers are content guidance rather than the trigger, or are cut off. Flood Risk Assessment: 'should include the following; ·' (source: 1ha+ in FZ1, all FZ2/3, surface water flood risk). Fire Statement uses form-contents text (source: London Plan fire statement for all applications, Gateway One for 18m+/7+ storeys with 2+ dwellings). HIA: 'a full HIA will be required.' (source: rapid HIA all majors, full HIA if GLA-referable). EIA: 'normally only necessary for a small proportion'. Transport Assessment and Travel Plan triggers are guidance links (source: TA for majors and significant transport impacts; Transport Statement for schools, nurseries, hospitals, places of worship, 100 sqm+ Class E; Travel Plan for all majors). Parking trigger is cut off at 'All applications where Plans should include details of'. Structural Survey: 'or Chartered Structural Engineer.' (source: significant works to existing historic buildings incl. basements). Retail Impact Assessment is missing the 2,500 sqm out-of-centre threshold. Drainage/SuDS (Full planning) is missing 'all majors and sites in a critical drainage area'.
issues.evidence: Validation Local List Feb 2024 entries for each item

issues.detail: Householder 'Street scene elevations' is listed as a requirement, but the Householder list marks it advisory only. Householder 'Waste / Refuse and recycling storage' reuses the basement Construction Management Plan trigger; the source has no householder waste storage requirement (the site waste management plan sits inside the basement CEMP).
issues.evidence: Householder list: 'Please note, whilst not a validation requirement, Streetscene elevations would assist...'

issues.detail: Several tab_items and rows are process text, fees or guidance, not requirements. These include the 10-working-day invalid notice and administration charges (GBP 150 major / GBP 35 other), pre-application service text, 'We will work with you to reduce the risk...', the fast-track service description, hard-copy delay text, the list's introductory paragraph, and five Biodiversity Checklist purpose/explanation sentences. App-type rows 'Pre-application advice / engagement details' and 'Habitats Regulations Assessment information / SPA mitigation' (a glossary of site designations from the Biodiversity Checklist) do not match any requirement in the list.
issues.evidence: e.g. 'Administration Charge - Invalid Major Application GBP 150 per application'

issues.detail: Transport Assessment and Travel Plan share the same guidance excerpt. Arboricultural Impact Assessment and 'Schedule of works (listed building)' both use the tree AMS sentence. Householder CEMP and Waste rows share one excerpt. The Drainage/SuDS trigger appears under 'Submission rules' in tab_items, while the app-type row has a different, trigger-less excerpt.

summary: Grokbot's reference link points to the Section 3 tick-box checklist DOCX, not the Validation Local List PDF (February 2024, adopted 1 May 2024), and its date comes from the upload folder. The extraction misses about 20 local requirements, including the Heritage Statement and the outline, reserved matters and S96A items, and many triggers are taken from neighbouring entries.
